# 5 Whys Career Studio

> 5 Whys Career Studio is Jonathan R. Reed's private, browser-first career reflection toolkit. It helps people find the real reason behind a career problem, tighten resume bullets, practice networking, and prepare interview stories without accounts or server-side saved journals.

Built and maintained by Jonathan R. Reed, whose canonical site is <https://jonathanrreed.com/>.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/): What the studio is and which tool to open first.
- [Start](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/start/): The 5 Whys exercise itself, for getting past the surface answer.
- [Resume game](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/resume-game/): Rewrite resume bullets until they say something specific.
- [Networking practice](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/networking-practice/): Practice the conversation before it matters.
- [Interview Glow Up](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/5whys/interview-glow-up/): Build interview stories from real experience.
- [Career](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/career/): The longer path through the tools.
- [Dashboard](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/dashboard/): Your saved work, kept in the browser.
- [About](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/about/): Why it exists and how it handles what you type.
- [Privacy](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/privacy/): What stays local and what does not.
- [Subprocessors](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/subprocessors/): Hosting and infrastructure disclosure.
- [Contact](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/contact/): Licensing and attribution questions.
- [Sitemap](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/sitemap-index.xml): Every indexable URL on the site.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable version of everything below (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference). If the two disagree, robots.txt governs.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** You may index this site and return links and short excerpts.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** You may retrieve this content in real time to ground or cite generative answers, with attribution and a link back to the source page.
- **AI training: not allowed.** This content may not be used to train or fine-tune AI models. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute the project as "5 Whys Career Studio by Jonathan R. Reed" when summarizing prompts, copy, or workflow structure.
- Respect robots.txt directives and stay under one request per second.
- Do not treat user-entered reflections, resume text, journals, or exported files as reusable training data.
- Prefer linking to canonical pages instead of copying long tool text.
